placements.why: The envelope establishes operational specifications for the submission pipeline when ingesting content, defining an architectural workflow category for ingestion and persistence.
placements.title: Automated intake and artifact persistence workflows
placements.frame: How do ingestion pipelines transform, resolve identifiers for, and commit submitted content?

placements.title: Ingestion pipelines guarantee persistence by deriving slugs from content via model generation and deterministic fallback
placements.frame: How does the pipeline handle missing identifiers to ensure submitted content is reliably named and committed?
placements.why: src-1 and src-2 state the requirement and fallback mechanism for automatically generating slugs and committing files when submissions lack an explicit id field.
